    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理(2.Token 到底是什么？)</span>

            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">最近正好有空,打算抽时间复盘总结一下这些年零零散散学习的AI知识.</p>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">下面是目录</p>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633"><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/GuZhenYin/p/20983335">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理目录 - GuZhenYin - 博客园</a></p>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">上一章我们大概总结了一下LLM到底是什么,这一章我们主要讲在LLM中 经常提及和广为人知的Token到底是什么.</p>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">首先,我们先从一个疑问开始.</p>
<h2 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1fmo2vw" data-start="731" data-end="750">2.1 为什么大模型看不懂文字？</h2>
<p data-start="752" data-end="774">第一次接触大模型时，很多人都会产生一个疑问：</p>
<blockquote data-start="776" data-end="810">
<p data-start="778" data-end="810">ChatGPT 为什么能够读懂中文、英文、日文，甚至还能写代码？</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="812" data-end="833">是不是模型里面真的存放了一个"中文字典"？</p>
<p data-start="835" data-end="859">或者，它是不是像我们一样，一眼就能看到一个汉字？</p>
<p data-start="861" data-end="868">答案都是否定。</p>
<p data-start="870" data-end="891">对于计算机来说，并不存在"文字"这种概念。</p>
<p data-start="893" data-end="909">计算机能够处理的，永远只有数字。</p>
<p data-start="911" data-end="927">例如，你现在看到屏幕上的一个字：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>你</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="940" data-end="953">在人眼里，它就是一个汉字。</p>
<p data-start="955" data-end="986">但在计算机内部，它通常会先表示成 Unicode 编码，例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>U+4F60</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1004" data-end="1016">继续转换之后，又会变成：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>01001111……</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1038" data-end="1048">也就是一长串二进制。</p>
<p data-start="1050" data-end="1055">也就是说：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1057" data-end="1092">
<p data-start="1059" data-end="1092"><strong data-start="1059" data-end="1092">计算机从来没有真正见过"你"这个字，它看到的始终只是数字。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1094" data-end="1106">大语言模型当然也是一样。</p>
<p data-start="1108" data-end="1138">因此，当我们把一句中文发送给模型时，它首先必须完成一件事情：</p>
<p data-start="1140" data-end="1160"><strong data-start="1140" data-end="1160">把文字转换成模型能够理解的数字。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1162" data-end="1178">但是，这里马上会出现另一个问题。</p>
<hr data-start="1180" data-end="1183">
<h2 data-section-id="pb1jmz" data-start="1185" data-end="1207">2.2 为什么不能一个字对应一个数字？</h2>
<p data-start="1209" data-end="1225">假设我们设计一个最简单的大模型。</p>
<p data-start="1227" data-end="1232">我们规定：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>你 → 1<br><br>好 → 2<br><br>世 → 3<br><br>界 → 4</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1270" data-end="1273">这样：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>你好世界</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1289" data-end="1299">是不是就可以转换成：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>1 2 3 4</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1318" data-end="1326">看起来非常简单。</p>
<p data-start="1328" data-end="1357">为什么现实中的 GPT、Claude、Qwen 不这么做？</p>
<p data-start="1359" data-end="1366">原因只有一个：</p>
<p data-start="1368" data-end="1377"><strong data-start="1368" data-end="1377">效率太低。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1379" data-end="1384">举个例子。</p>
<p data-start="1386" data-end="1390">中文里：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>中华人民共和国</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1409" data-end="1419">如果每个字单独处理。</p>
<p data-start="1421" data-end="1424">需要：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>中<br>华<br>人<br>民<br>共<br>和<br>国</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1455" data-end="1460">七次处理。</p>
<p data-start="1462" data-end="1465">但是：</p>
<p data-start="1467" data-end="1474">如果模型发现：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>中华人民共和国</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1493" data-end="1504">这个词出现了几千万次。</p>
<p data-start="1506" data-end="1516">它完全可以把它当成：</p>
<p data-start="1518" data-end="1523">一个整体。</p>
<p data-start="1525" data-end="1528">例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>中华人民共和国<br>↓<br>一个Token</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1559" data-end="1562">这样：</p>
<p data-start="1564" data-end="1573">模型一次就能识别。</p>
<p data-start="1575" data-end="1580">速度更快。</p>
<p data-start="1582" data-end="1591">表达的信息也更多。</p>
<p data-start="1593" data-end="1607">再举一个程序员更熟悉的例子。</p>
<p data-start="1609" data-end="1616">Python：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>__init__</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1636" data-end="1641">如果拆成：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>_<br>_<br>i<br>n<br>i<br>t</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1669" data-end="1674">毫无意义。</p>
<p data-start="1676" data-end="1682">模型更希望按如下定义token,这样才能更清晰的表示它的维度：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>__init__<br><br>↓<br><br>一个Token</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1714" data-end="1717">因此：</p>
<p data-start="1719" data-end="1727">模型并不是按照汉字或者单词去理解世界。</p>
<p data-start="1754" data-end="1765">而是按照这种新的单位：<strong data-start="1767" data-end="1777">Token。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="1779" data-end="1782">
<h2 data-section-id="i1wn0p" data-start="1784" data-end="1801">2.3 什么是 Token？</h2>
<p data-start="1803" data-end="1819">其实在3月23日中国发展高层论坛2026年年会上，国家数据局局长刘烈宏正式公布，AI领域核心概念Token的标准中文译名为&nbsp;&nbsp;<strong>词元&nbsp;</strong>。这一中文语义其实是相当精准的。</p>
<p data-start="1839" data-end="1850">但容易让初学者误以为,Token 就是一个词。</p>
<p data-start="1869" data-end="1876">其实完全不是，更准确一点，可以把它理解成：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1894" data-end="1916">
<p data-start="1896" data-end="1916"><strong data-start="1896" data-end="1916">模型自己发明的一套"文字积木"。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1918" data-end="1923">这些积木，有的大，有的小，有的是一个字，有的是半个单词，有的是整个句子。甚至，还有可能只是一个空格。</p>
<p data-start="1987" data-end="1995">举几个真实例子。</p>
<p data-start="1997" data-end="2000">英文：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">

<p data-start="2039" data-end="2048">一个 Token。</p>

<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">

</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<p data-start="2077" data-end="2083">有可能变成：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">

<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">

<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>un<br>believ<br>able</code></pre>

</div>

</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2111" data-end="2120">三个 Token。</p>
<p data-start="2111" data-end="2120">有兴趣的可以去openai的Tokenizer试试,地址:<a href="https://platform.openai.com/tokenizer" rel="noopener nofollow">Tokenizer - OpenAI API</a></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/653851/202606/653851-20260630162110646-1140252937.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>中文呢? 其实也一样,每个模型的规则都可能会有区别</p>
<p data-start="2122" data-end="2125">中文：</p>

</div>

</div>
<p data-start="2139" data-end="2144">有些模型：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">

</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2160" data-end="2169">两个 Token。</p>
<p data-start="2171" data-end="2176">有些模型：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">

<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">

</div>
</div>

<p data-start="2190" data-end="2201">就是一个 Token。</p>
<p data-start="2203" data-end="2206">代码：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">

<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>System.out.println</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2236" data-end="2240">很可能整个就是一个 Token。</p>
<p data-start="2260" data-end="2263">因此<strong data-start="2265" data-end="2283">Token 并没有固定长度。</strong></p>
<p data-start="2285" data-end="2294">它唯一的目标就是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2296" data-end="2316">
<p data-start="2298" data-end="2316"><strong data-start="2298" data-end="2316">让模型能够更高效地表示语言。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="2318" data-end="2321">
<h2 data-section-id="eqm0ox" data-start="2323" data-end="2342">2.4 Token 是怎么来的？</h2>
<p data-start="2344" data-end="2363">很多人第一次看到 Token，会认为：</p>
<p data-start="2365" data-end="2378">是不是程序员提前规定好的？</p>
<p data-start="2380" data-end="2383">例如:你好. 编号是:1234</p>
<p data-start="2410" data-end="2415">其实不然。</p>
<p data-start="2417" data-end="2454">现代大语言模型中的 Token，大多数都是<strong data-start="2438" data-end="2453">通过算法自动学习出来的</strong>。</p>
<p data-start="2456" data-end="2475">训练模型之前，工程师会先收集互联网上的海量文本。</p>
<p data-start="2477" data-end="2480">例如：</p>
<ul data-start="2482" data-end="2529">
<li data-section-id="yhvf5f" data-start="2482" data-end="2486">小说</li>
<li data-section-id="yhttr7" data-start="2487" data-end="2491">新闻</li>
<li data-section-id="yi82c5" data-start="2492" data-end="2496">论文</li>
<li data-section-id="1xdrp7x" data-start="2497" data-end="2505">GitHub</li>
<li data-section-id="11v1x16" data-start="2506" data-end="2522">Stack Overflow</li>
<li data-section-id="1n3kt8j" data-start="2523" data-end="2529">技术文档</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="2531" data-end="2536">然后统计,哪些字符经常一起出现,举个例子:</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>中华人民共和国</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2580" data-end="2591">每天都会出现几十万次。</p>
<p data-start="2593" data-end="2602">那么算法就会认为&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<code>中华人民共和国&nbsp;</code>应该作为,一个整体。而不是七个汉字。</p>
<p data-start="2648" data-end="2651">同样,程序代码里面：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;<code>public static void</code></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;经常一起出现。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2699" data-end="2723">模型也可能把其中一部分组合成更大的 Token。</p>
<p data-start="2725" data-end="2757">这种自动合并过程，就是现代 Tokenizer 的核心思想之一。</p>
<p data-start="2759" data-end="2769">它并不是理解了语言。</p>
<p data-start="2771" data-end="2774">而是：</p>
<p data-start="2776" data-end="2809"><strong data-start="2776" data-end="2809">根据统计规律，把经常一起出现的字符组合成一个 Token。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="2811" data-end="2814">
<h2 data-section-id="1f154sv" data-start="2816" data-end="2842">2.5 为什么不同模型 Token 数量不同？</h2>
<p data-start="2844" data-end="2862">很多人第一次使用 API 时会发现,同一段文字,每个模型消耗的token可能不太一样.</p>
<p data-start="2872" data-end="2876">GPT：</p>
<p data-start="2883" data-end="2893">120 Token。</p>
<p data-start="2895" data-end="2902">Claude：</p>
<p data-start="2904" data-end="2914">110 Token。</p>
<p data-start="2916" data-end="2921">Qwen：</p>
<p data-start="2923" data-end="2932">95 Token。</p>
<p data-start="2934" data-end="2938">为什么？答案很简单,因为它们使用的是<strong data-start="2962" data-end="2980">不同的 Tokenizer,</strong>也就是说,大家使用的是不同的一套"积木"。</p>
<p data-start="3010" data-end="3016">有的人喜欢大积木,有的人喜欢小积木。</p>
<p data-start="3038" data-end="3043">举个例子。</p>
<p data-start="3045" data-end="3048">一句：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>人工智能正在改变世界</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3070" data-end="3075">模型 A：</p>
<p data-start="3077" data-end="3082">可能拆成：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>人工智能<br>正在<br>改变<br>世界</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3110" data-end="3119">四个 Token。</p>
<p data-start="3121" data-end="3126">模型 B：</p>
<p data-start="3128" data-end="3133">可能拆成：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>人工<br>智能<br>正在<br>改变<br>世界</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3163" data-end="3172">五个 Token。</p>
<p data-start="3174" data-end="3179">模型 C：</p>
<p data-start="3181" data-end="3186">甚至可能：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>人<br>工<br>智<br>能<br>……</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3212" data-end="3221">更多 Token。</p>
<p data-start="3223" data-end="3226">因此<strong data-start="3228" data-end="3251">Token 数量不能直接比较模型性能。</strong></p>
<p data-start="3253" data-end="3257">它只是Tokenizer 的设计不同,当然Tokenizer 设计的好,对模型的准确性还是帮助很大的。</p>
<hr data-start="3277" data-end="3280">
<h2 data-section-id="vhyay6" data-start="3282" data-end="3305">2.6 Token 和 Token ID</h2>
<p data-start="3307" data-end="3312">到了这里,模型已经有了一堆 Token。</p>
<p data-start="3331" data-end="3334">例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>你好<br>世界<br>苹果<br>今天<br>....</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3360" data-end="3363">但是,模型仍然不能直接处理这些 Token。</p>
<p data-start="3386" data-end="3389">因为Token 本质还是字符串。</p>
<p data-start="3407" data-end="3417">计算机真正喜欢的是整数。</p>
<p data-start="3424" data-end="3427">于是每一个 Token,都会获得一个唯一编号。</p>
<div style="text-align: left" data-start="3454" data-end="3457">例如：</div>
<div class="TyagGW_tableContainer" style="text-align: left">
<div class="group TyagGW_tableWrapper flex flex-col-reverse w-fit">
<table class="w-fit min-w-(--thread-content-width)" data-start="3459" data-end="3558">
<thead data-start="3459" data-end="3479">
<tr data-start="3459" data-end="3479"><th class="last:pe-10" style="text-align: left" data-start="3459" data-end="3467" data-col-size="sm">Token</th><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="3467" data-end="3479" data-col-size="sm">Token ID</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody data-start="3504" data-end="3558">
<tr data-start="3504" data-end="3517">
<td data-start="3504" data-end="3509" data-col-size="sm">你好</td>
<td data-col-size="sm" data-start="3509" data-end="3517">1542</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="3518" data-end="3530">
<td data-start="3518" data-end="3523" data-col-size="sm">世界</td>
<td data-start="3523" data-end="3530" data-col-size="sm">825</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="3531" data-end="3545">
<td data-start="3531" data-end="3536" data-col-size="sm">苹果</td>
<td data-col-size="sm" data-start="3536" data-end="3545">21698</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="3546" data-end="3558">
<td data-start="3546" data-end="3551" data-col-size="sm">今天</td>
<td data-col-size="sm" data-start="3551" data-end="3558">471</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div style="text-align: left" data-start="3560" data-end="3563">于是：</div>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>你好 世界</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3580" data-end="3589">在真正送进模型之前,已经变成：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>1542<br>825</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3617" data-end="3620">注意,这里的编号<strong data-start="3630" data-end="3643">没有任何数学意义。</strong></p>
<p data-start="3645" data-end="3661">1542 不比 825 更高级。</p>
<p data-start="3663" data-end="3667">它只是字典里的编号。</p>
<p data-start="3678" data-end="3681">很像我们常见的新华字典：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>苹果<br>在第100页</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3710" data-end="3715">并不代表：</p>
<p data-start="3717" data-end="3736">苹果这个词比香蕉更重要。</p>
<hr data-start="3738" data-end="3741">
<h2 data-section-id="uz8ea2" data-start="3743" data-end="3754">2.7 本章总结</h2>
<p data-start="3756" data-end="3780">这一章，我们回答了一个看似简单却非常重要的问题：</p>
<p data-start="3782" data-end="3818"><strong data-start="3782" data-end="3818">为什么大语言模型眼里没有"字"、没有"单词"，只有 Token？</strong></p>
<p data-start="3820" data-end="3838">现在，我们应该建立起下面这张知识地图：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>用户输入文本<br>        │<br>        ▼<br>   Tokenizer（切分）<br>        │<br>        ▼<br>      Token<br>        │<br>        ▼<br>     Token ID<br>        │<br>        ▼<br>（下一章）<br>大模型绕不开的核心--Transformer<br></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3995" data-end="4007">这一章我们需要记住三个关键内容：</p>
<ol data-start="4009" data-end="4243">
<li data-section-id="1mgfra5" data-start="4009" data-end="4055"><strong data-start="4012" data-end="4055">Token 不是字，也不是单词，而是模型为了高效表示语言而构建的基本处理单元。</strong></li>
<li data-section-id="lzdxrl" data-start="4056" data-end="4141"><strong data-start="4059" data-end="4141">不同模型拥有不同的 Tokenizer，因此同一段文本在不同模型中的 Token 数量可能完全不同，这也是不同 API Token 计费存在差异的重要原因。</strong></li>
<li data-section-id="106jhuw" data-start="4142" data-end="4243"><strong data-start="4145" data-end="4243">Token ID 只是 Token 在词表中的编号，本身不携带语义信息。真正让模型理解"苹果""北京""程序员"这些概念的，并不是编号，而是下一章将讲到的内容——Embedding（词向量）。</strong></li>
</ol>

</div>
